'''Vvaw''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Jmmaar" /> located in the [[Vvaw system/Legends|Vvaw system]], a part of the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]]<ref name="EAOC Vvaw" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Vvaw" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jmmaar/Legends|Jmmaar]], a member of the [[Viraanntesse]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="CSWE Jmmaar" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|species=[[Viraanntesse]]|system=[[Viraanntesse system/Legends|Viraanntesse system]]|legends=1}}</ref> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Viraanntesse system/Legends|Viraanntesse system]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from Vvaw.<ref name="CSWE Jmmaar" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vvaw was first mentioned in [[Curtis Saxton]]'s [[2005]] [[Book/Legends|reference book]] ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''.<ref name="RotSCross">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Vvaw [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square U-9.<ref name="TEA" />
